elements.name: Customer updates payment method for active subscription

steps.name: a customer has an active subscription with an expired card
the customer updates their payment method
the subscription stores only the payment provider token

elements.name: Failed invoice is retried after payment method update

steps.name: a customer has a past due invoice
the customer updates their payment method
the billing service retries the failed invoice once

elements.name: Payment retry uses idempotency to avoid duplicate charges

steps.name: a retry request is submitted twice for the same failed invoice
the billing service handles the second retry request
it returns the original retry result without creating another charge
